Creation. - There is hereby created the Presidential Task Force to Assess, Plan
and Monitor the Entire Educational System.

Composition and Organization. - The Task Forcr shall be composed of the
1.) Secretary, Department of Education
2.) Chairman, Commission on Higher Education
3.) Chairman, Technical Education and Skills Development Authority
4.) Presidential Assistant for Education
5.) Five (5) representatives from the private sector to be appointed/designated by the

The Chairman of the Task force shall be designated by the President from among the
representatives from the private sector, and co-chaired by the Chairman, Commission on
Higher Education.

Powers and Functions. - The Task Force shall exercise the following functions
1. To design a mechanism in the holding of regular for a for trans-subsectoral
consultations on cross-cutting policies and programs;
2.
To identify strategies to dovetail the goals and objectives of the education
system, especially tertiary education, to -nationaldevelopment plans;
3. To review existing and proposed programs from all the three (3) education
agencies of government and other government agencies with education programs
for tighter inter-subsector coordination;
4. To provide guidelines in setting priorities for the education system, especially
tertiary education, and recommend corresponding financial requirements;
5. To design the monitoring scheme for the implementation of reforms proposed by
the PCER as updated by the Medium Term Philippine Development Plan of the
Arroyo administration, especially on tertiary education;
6. To provide directions in the establishment of the National Educational Evaluation
and Testing Systems and Operations, as well as oversee and monitor the
implementation thereof;
and provide
guidelines for Philippine
representatives
international and national conferences/meetings with cross-cutting themes or
concerns in education; and
8. To lead in the convening of a biennial National Congress in Education involving
the three (3) levels for the purpose of assessing, updating/upgrading and
strengthening the entire educational system and its components.

Inter-Agency Assistance and Coordination. - All other departments, bureaus,
offices, agencies and instrumentalities of the government, including government-owned
or controlJed corporations, are hereby directed to cooperate with the Task Force in the
performance of its mandate under this Executive Order.

Rewards. - The members of the Task Force shalJ be entitled to rewards,
incentives and other entitlements as may be provided under existing laws and pertinent
rules and regulations.

Report. - The Task force shall submit its report and proposal to the President
not later than twelve (12) months from the start of its function.

Funding. - The funds for the Task Force shall be drawn from the budget of the
PA for Education as specified in Section 12 of EO 273 (Series of 2000) as amended by

Repealing Clause. - All other orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

Effecitivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 21st day of August, in the year of Our Lord, two

By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
